name: Jackie Ng
title: Structural Biologist · Drug Delivery · Founder of AtomBios
tagline: Engineering nanoparticles that cross the blood-brain barrier.
description: Structural biologist applying cryo-EM and computational tools to drug delivery. Five cryo-EM structures solved, best at 2.7 Å. Founder of AtomBios: 20nm nanoparticles, 8× BBB transcytosis and HK$7.05M funded.
